description: This file contains functions for converting internal RRC (Radio Resource Control) configurations and identifiers to ASN.1 representations and vice versa, specifically for 5G NR (New Radio) protocols. It includes conversions for PDCP, SDAP, security algorithms, and RAN notification area info.

methods.name: discard_timer_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_discard_timer enum to ASN.1 discard_timer_e_ representation.

methods.name: t_reordering_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_t_reordering enum to ASN.1 t_reordering_e_ representation.

methods.name: pdcp_config_to_rrc_nr_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal pdcp_config structure to ASN.1 rrc_nr::pdcp_cfg_s.

methods.name: sdap_hdr_ul_cfg_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts SDAP UL header configuration to ASN.1 options.

methods.name: sdap_hdr_dl_cfg_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts SDAP DL header configuration to ASN.1 options.

methods.name: sdap_config_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal SDAP configuration to ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: ciphering_algorithm_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal ciphering algorithm enum to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: integrity_prot_algorithm_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal integrity algorithm enum to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: asn1_to_five_g_s_tmsi
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 fixed_bitstring to internal five_g_s_tmsi structure.

methods.name: asn1_to_amf_identifier
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 fixed_bitstring to internal AMF identifier structure.

methods.name: asn1_to_establishment_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 establishment cause options to internal cause enum.

methods.name: asn1_to_resume_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 resume cause options to internal cause enum.

methods.name: asn1_resume_cause_to_establishment_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 resume cause to internal establishment cause enum.

methods.name: ran_paging_cycle_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a paging cycle value to ASN.1 enumerated type.

methods.name: plmn_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal PLMN identity to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: ran_notification_area_info_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal RAN notification area info to ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: radio_bearer_config_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal radio bearer configuration to ASN.1 structure.
